title: Comparative materials for ‘The Constitution as a Founding Inscription: Social Ontology and Comparative Legal Traditions’
description:
Comparative datasets underlying the article The Constitution as a Founding Inscription: Social Ontology and Comparative Legal Traditions (Luis Bourguet), accepted for publication in the Revista General de Derecho Público Comparado (IUSTEL), September 2026.

Contents: ten legal traditions (Glenn's map) by point of capture, mode of inscription, technology of hardness and exemplary orders (article § 5.9); twenty-one constitutional orders by founding act, technology of intangibility and mode of recognition of the other (§ 10); the ichnological hierarchy of inscription (§ 6); the twelve constitutional provisions quoted in the article; all primary sources cited; and a codebook. Constitutional texts were retrieved from the Comparative Constitutions Project (Constitute).

The pre-review preprint of the article is a separate record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21386477. The accepted manuscript is not deposited, in accordance with the journal's copyright policy.

Version 2 (v1.2.0) separates the dataset from the preprint: the preprint PDF included in v1.1.0 has been removed from this record; it remains available at its own DOI.
